scenes.conflict: Mother Tithe's enzyme secretions are dangerous to touch, and Tamsin's attachment to the creature tempts her to get closer than is safe.
scenes.goal: Tamsin tries to understand why Mother Tithe is behaving strangely after a harvest crew returned speaking in unison.
scenes.outcome: Tamsin records unmistakable signs of intent in Mother Tithe's behavior and decides to report them to Dorian.
scenes.summary: Tending Mother Tithe in the Brood Cathedral, Tamsin sees the leviathan answer the murmurs of the infected crew and understands the sentience is real.
scenes.title: The First Murmur

scenes.conflict: Oren speaks in layered voices and asks Bram to stand down, while Bram's instinct is to contain the infected workers by force.
scenes.goal: Bram wants to find out what happened to his harvest crew and restore production.
scenes.outcome: Bram has the infected crew sealed in a trench corridor, defying his own grief over Oren, and the unrest begins to spread.
scenes.summary: Bram confronts his oldest friend Oren, who now speaks for the Chorus, and answers the plea with force.
scenes.title: The Crew Returns Singing

scenes.conflict: Bram's sealed corridors strand infected workers in the Pressure Ring and strain scarce supplies, and Mira hides her own exposure from Ines.
scenes.goal: Mira wants to show Ines clinical evidence that the sentience is an infection spreading through enzyme contact.
scenes.outcome: Ines accepts the data and resolves to prepare an evacuation plan, while Mira conceals her symptoms.
scenes.summary: Mira brings her hand-written infection ledger to Ines, who sees the pattern and recognizes the scale of the threat.
scenes.title: The Infirmary Ledger

scenes.conflict: Each acts under delayed shareholder oversight and heavy legal exposure, so none can agree and none will yield.
scenes.goal: Each head argues for a plan: Ines wants evacuation or quarantine, Dorian wants to secure Mother Tithe, and Bram wants production maintained.
scenes.outcome: The meeting deadlocks, Dorian files reports that undermine Ines's authority, and the three leaders begin acting separately.
scenes.summary: The three rival heads clash in front of remote shareholder feeds and split the colony's response three ways.
scenes.title: Board Gallery Standoff

scenes.conflict: Tamsin sees Mother Tithe as a sentient being and resists handing her over, while Dorian leans on her loyalty and his control of vault access.
scenes.goal: Dorian wants Tamsin's observation data on Mother Tithe to build his patent claim.
scenes.outcome: Tamsin gives up partial data under pressure, then resolves to find a way to talk to the creature herself.
scenes.summary: Dorian pressures Tamsin in the cold Assay Vaults and she realizes he intends to sell Mother Tithe.
scenes.title: Vault Leverage

scenes.conflict: Bram refuses to halt production and his sealed sections degrade the air, while Ines hesitates without shareholder authorization.
scenes.goal: Ines wants to start allocating suits and transit tubes for evacuation, and needs Bram's cooperation.
scenes.outcome: Air readings show the scrubbers failing faster, and Ines hesitates to act without legal cover, which costs the colony time.
scenes.summary: Ines and Bram argue over sealed corridors as Mira's data shows the air is running out.
scenes.title: Air Budget

scenes.conflict: Oren's will is entangled with the collective's, and Tamsin risks enzyme exposure and manipulation by those speaking for Mother Tithe.
scenes.goal: Tamsin wants to understand what the Chorus wants and whether Mother Tithe is suffering.
scenes.outcome: Oren reveals the Chorus wants to gather around Mother Tithe, and Tamsin becomes the first to translate between the hive and the executives.
scenes.summary: Tamsin enters the trench in a pressure suit and learns the Chorus seeks protected unity, not conquest.
scenes.title: Speaking to the Chorus

scenes.conflict: Her symptoms surface in front of Ines, who must choose between protecting her aide and following quarantine protocol.
scenes.goal: Mira wants to keep working on a treatment without being quarantined.
scenes.outcome: Mira confesses her exposure and offers herself as a test case, giving Ines evidence for the evacuation and a reason to break protocol.
scenes.summary: Ines discovers that her most trusted aide is infected, and Mira volunteers to become the key to a treatment.
scenes.title: Mira's Secret

scenes.conflict: The two rivals contest control of the Brood Cathedral while Tamsin tries to keep both away from the creature and the enzyme secretions threaten everyone present.
scenes.goal: Dorian moves to secure Mother Tithe while Bram sends crews to claim her as an Extraction asset.
scenes.outcome: A standoff leaves both leaders exposed to enzymes, Dorian's judgment begins to erode, and Bram's crew defects to the Chorus.
scenes.summary: Genomics and Extraction forces collide over Mother Tithe, and the contagion spreads among them.
scenes.title: The Brood Seizure

scenes.conflict: Acting without authorization risks Ines's career and the colony's liability protections, and Dorian uses the delayed uplink to block her.
scenes.goal: Ines wants to issue the evacuation order, and Dorian wants to delegitimize it through shareholder reports.
scenes.outcome: Ines breaks the shareholder uplink protocol and takes personal responsibility for the evacuation, while Dorian turns reckless.
scenes.summary: Ines defies her insurers and the order goes out against Dorian's obstruction.
scenes.title: Breaking the Uplink

scenes.conflict: Bram fears the Chorus and must face the cost of his past crackdown, while Oren's disregard for individual consent puts the survivors at risk.
scenes.goal: Ines wants Bram's crews and the Chorus to cooperate on a joint evacuation and quarantine plan.
scenes.outcome: Bram stands down his containment forces and Oren agrees to let uninfected workers leave, but Mother Tithe is still in Dorian's hands.
scenes.summary: With Tamsin translating and Mira's data as proof, Bram and Oren put aside their grievance and the coalition forms.
scenes.title: A Fragile Coalition

scenes.conflict: Dorian's pride and enzyme exposure cloud his judgment as the air fails and the Chorus gathers around Mother Tithe.
scenes.goal: Dorian wants to ship Mother Tithe and her data out before the evacuation, while the others want to stop him and save the colony.
scenes.outcome: Dorian is forced to choose between his masterwork and his survival, gives up the claim on Mother Tithe, and the evacuation of the uninfected begins.
scenes.summary: The leaders and the Chorus converge on Mother Tithe, and Dorian's sale collapses.
scenes.title: The Choice at the Cathedral

scenes.conflict: The limited scrubbers, the shortage of suits and tubes, and Mira's worsening infection force hard choices about who goes.
scenes.goal: Ines and Bram want to move the uninfected workers to safety before the air runs out.
scenes.outcome: Most uninfected workers are evacuated, and Mira stays behind with the infected to continue her work.
scenes.summary: Ines and Bram run the evacuation, and Bram chooses the people he swore to protect over production.
scenes.title: Sealed Transit

scenes.conflict: Dorian and Bram face the cost of their own decisions, and the shareholders' delayed response leaves everyone legally exposed.
scenes.goal: Ines wants to report the evacuation to shareholders and take responsibility for her choices.
scenes.outcome: Ines accepts the blame, Dorian relinquishes his patent claim, and Bram resigns his command, so the colony's future is left to negotiation with the Chorus.
scenes.summary: The three rivals face the consequences of the crisis in the Board Gallery.
scenes.title: Accounting for the Shares

scenes.conflict: Oren's fragment of selfhood resists the collective's urge to absorb everyone, while Bram must trust the friend he once sealed away.
scenes.goal: Tamsin and Bram want to set terms for coexistence between the Chorus and the remaining crews.
scenes.outcome: Oren rediscovers his individuality and shapes the Chorus toward negotiation, leaving a fragile truce around Mother Tithe.
scenes.summary: In the trench, old friends renegotiate the future of the colony and a truce is set.
scenes.title: A Negotiated Tide

logline: When Mother Tithe's contagious sentience turns Mariana Six's workers into a hive mind, three rival department heads must choose between evacuating the failing station, keeping production running, or securing the creature for their shareholders before the air runs out.
title: Abyssal Shares
